referees.quote: the results can eventually be published. However, the interpretation of data leading to the major conclusion that all the Fermi surfaces are hole-pocket like is not very clearly documented
there still remains unclear issue associated with the data analysis. Therefore, I do not recommend publication of this manuscript in its current form in Nature Communications.
I find some of the claims to be overstepping. I would like to see more supporting evidence or a softening of the conclusions before publication.

note: The first round is Version 0 at Nature Communications; there is no sign of a transfer from another journal. No referee uses the scale words, so all three are inferred. R1 asks for clearer support for the hole-pocket interpretation plus added discussion. R2 asks for additional analyses, including Fermi-function-divided spectra and temperature-dependent EDCs for the δ band. R3 asks for further evidence or softened claims on Tc, doping assignment and antinodal states. Later rounds: R2 and R3 recommend publication. In Version 1, R3's report as quoted in the author rebuttal says 'I cannot recommend this manuscript for publication'; the reviewer comments section left that report blank.
